title: "Bonds on curves and curve risk"
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
source("R/book.R")
source("R/quantlib_side.R")
```

**No row of this chapter has a verdict: the legacy text has no value to use as the baseline.** The legacy text computes curve risk on a swap and on a short cash flow list with `torch`, and neither is in the public API of RiemannFinMath. The items here use the TONAR curve of the OIS chapter and a bond that is not in the legacy text. QuantLib has no automatic differentiation in its R binding, so its side is a central difference that rebuilds the curve, with a bump of 1e-6 in rate.

## Inputs

```{r}
#| label: inputs
date <- "2022-08-19"
quotes <- lagrange_object("part2_quantive_riemann/ch03_ois_swaps_multicurve.qmd", "tona_quotes", trade_date_tona = date) |>
  mutate(tenor = if_else(kind == "overnight_deposit", "ON", tenor)) |>
  select(tenor, rate)
bond_terms <- list(issue = "2022-03-20", maturity = "2029-03-20", coupon = 0.002)
show_inputs(c(
  list(curve = "TONAR quotes of chapter 4, section TONAR", interpolation = "log-linear", evaluation = date),
  bond_terms, list(calendar = "Japan", tenor = "6M", day_count = "Actual/365 (Fixed)", settlement_days = 2L, payment = "following")
))
```

## Value on a curve

QuantLib:

```{r}
#| label: value-quantlib
build_quantlib <- function(rates) {
  ql_ois_curve(date, "tonar", QuantLib::Actual365Fixed(), quotes$tenor, rates, 2L, interpolation = "log_linear")
}
ql_set_evaluation_date(date)
ql_bond <- ql_fixed_bond(bond_terms$issue, bond_terms$maturity, bond_terms$coupon, QuantLib::Japan(), QuantLib::Actual365Fixed())
npv_on <- function(curve_object) {
  handle <- QuantLib::YieldTermStructureHandle(curve_object)
  QuantLib::Instrument_setPricingEngine(ql_bond, QuantLib::DiscountingBondEngine(handle))
  QuantLib::Instrument_NPV(ql_bond)
}
ql_curve <- build_quantlib(quotes$rate)
quantlib_value <- list(npv = npv_on(ql_curve$curve), clean = QuantLib::Bond_cleanPrice(ql_bond), dirty = QuantLib::Bond_dirtyPrice(ql_bond), settlement = QuantLib::Bond_settlementValue(ql_bond))
```

RiemannFinMath:

```{r}
#| label: value-riemann
build_riemann <- function(rates) {
  RiemannFinMath::build_ois_curve(
    date, date, "tonar", "actual_365_fixed", RiemannFinMath::ois_instruments(quotes$tenor, rates, 2L, 1L, 0L),
    interpolation = "log_linear"
  )
}
curve <- build_riemann(quotes$rate)
bond <- RiemannFinMath::fixed_rate_bond(
  settlement_days = 2L, face_amount = 100, effective_date = bond_terms$issue, termination_date = bond_terms$maturity,
  tenor = "6M", calendar = "japan", convention = "unadjusted", termination_convention = "unadjusted", rule = "backward",
  end_of_month = FALSE, coupon_rate = bond_terms$coupon, day_count = "actual_365_fixed", payment_convention = "following",
  redemption = 100, issue_date = bond_terms$issue
)
riemann_value <- RiemannFinMath::value_on_curve(bond, curve, date)
```

```{r}
#| label: value-results
bind_rows(
  compare_values("NPV", "per 100, at the curve date", quantlib_value$npv, riemann_value$npv),
  compare_values("Settlement value", "per 100, at settlement", quantlib_value$settlement, riemann_value$settlement_value),
  compare_values("Dirty price", "per 100, at settlement", quantlib_value$dirty, riemann_value$dirty_price),
  compare_values("Clean price", "per 100, at settlement", quantlib_value$clean, riemann_value$clean_price)
) |>
  show_results()
```

## Sensitivity to each quote

QuantLib, rebuilding the curve:

```{r}
#| label: quote-quantlib
h <- 1e-6
quantlib_quote_risk <- map_dbl(seq_len(nrow(quotes)), \(i) {
  bumped <- function(sign) {
    rates <- quotes$rate
    rates[i] <- rates[i] + sign * h
    npv_on(build_quantlib(rates)$curve)
  }
  (bumped(1) - bumped(-1)) / (2 * h) * 1e-4
})
```

RiemannFinMath, by automatic differentiation and the implicit function theorem:

```{r}
#| label: quote-riemann
riemann_quote_risk <- RiemannFinMath::quote_sensitivity(bond, curve, date)
```

```{r}
#| label: quote-results
compare_values(paste("Quote", quotes$tenor), "per 100, per bp of quote", quantlib_quote_risk, riemann_quote_risk$npv_per_bp) |>
  show_results()
```

## Sensitivity to each node

QuantLib, with a log-linear `DiscountCurve` on the same nodes, moving the continuous zero rate of one node:

```{r}
#| label: node-quantlib
nodes <- ql_nodes(ql_curve)
times <- as.numeric(nodes$date - as.Date(date)) / 365
discount_curve_of <- function(discounts) {
  dates <- do.call(QuantLib::DateVector, list())
  walk(nodes$date, \(d) QuantLib::DateVector_push_back(dates, ql_date(d)))
  QuantLib::DiscountCurve(dates, discounts, QuantLib::Actual365Fixed())
}
quantlib_node_risk <- map_dbl(seq_len(nrow(nodes))[-1], \(i) {
  bumped <- function(sign) {
    discounts <- nodes$discount
    discounts[i] <- discounts[i] * exp(-sign * h * times[i])
    npv_on(discount_curve_of(discounts))
  }
  (bumped(1) - bumped(-1)) / (2 * h) * 1e-4
})
```

RiemannFinMath:

```{r}
#| label: node-riemann
riemann_node_risk <- RiemannFinMath::curve_node_sensitivity(bond, curve, date)
```

```{r}
#| label: node-results
node_table <- riemann_node_risk |> filter(date %in% nodes$date[-1])
compare_values(
  paste("Node", format(node_table$date)), "per 100, per bp of zero rate",
  quantlib_node_risk[match(node_table$date, nodes$date[-1])], node_table$npv_per_bp
) |>
  show_results()
```

## Sensitivity to the yield

QuantLib has the duration and the convexity, and the derivatives follow from them. RiemannFinMath differentiates the price.

```{r}
#| label: yield-calls
yield_rate <- 0.01
ql_settlement <- QuantLib::Bond_settlementDate(ql_bond)
ql_dc <- QuantLib::Actual365Fixed()
ql_dirty <- QuantLib::BondFunctions_cleanPrice(ql_bond, yield_rate, ql_dc, "Compounded", "Semiannual", ql_settlement) + QuantLib::Bond_accruedAmount(ql_bond, ql_settlement)
ql_modified <- QuantLib::BondFunctions_duration(ql_bond, yield_rate, ql_dc, "Compounded", "Semiannual", "Modified", ql_settlement)
ql_convexity <- QuantLib::BondFunctions_convexity(ql_bond, yield_rate, ql_dc, "Compounded", "Semiannual", ql_settlement)
riemann_yield <- RiemannFinMath::yield_sensitivity(
  bond, yield_rate, "actual_365_fixed", "compounded", 2L, RiemannFinMath::settlement_date(bond, date)
)
```

```{r}
#| label: yield-results
bind_rows(
  compare_values("Dirty price", "per 100", ql_dirty, riemann_yield$dirty_price),
  compare_values("First derivative", "per 100, per bp", -ql_modified * ql_dirty * 1e-4, riemann_yield$d_price_d_yield * 1e-4),
  compare_values("Second derivative", "per 100, per percent squared", ql_convexity * ql_dirty * 1e-4, riemann_yield$d2_price_d_yield2 * 1e-4)
) |>
  show_results()
```

## Differences of wrapper and core

```{r}
#| label: design
tribble(
  ~Layer,    ~Aspect,             ~QuantLib,                                                     ~RiemannFinMath,
  "Wrapper", "Value on a curve",  "Set an engine on the bond, then read `NPV`",                  "`value_on_curve(bond, curve, date)`",
  "Wrapper", "Bucket risk",       "A loop written by the user, with a rebuild for each bump",    "One call returns the table",
  "Core",    "Derivatives",       "Not exposed in R; finite differences",                        "Reverse-mode automatic differentiation on a graph",
  "Core",    "Quote derivatives", "The bootstrap is repeated",                                   "Implicit function theorem on the solved curve",
  "Core",    "Cost",              "2 rebuilds for each quote",                                   "One backward pass",
  "Core",    "Past the last node", "Extrapolates when enabled on the curve",                     "An error, unless `with_extrapolation` made a new curve"
) |>
  show_design()
```
